text:
incident-bot: SEV2 alert: repeated GPU memory failures in cluster inference-gpu-pool-7 — multiple containers restarting (OOM). Creating thread for ops bridge.

dave: I'm on it. seeing container c-7f9a die with SIGKILL, kube reports restartCount=4. grabbing logs now.

sana: paste of kernel/GPU error: `CUDA out of memory when allocating 4.21 GiB` + stack that spikes during initial context load (warmup).

raj: here's the relevant snippet from the model runtime logs:
```
2026-03-18T02:12:34Z runtime ERROR: allocate() failed: out of memory
  model=llama-xxl-4096 shard=2 alloc=4294967296
  prefilling tokens: 110k (client request id=cli-9a3f)
```

ingrid: clients are sending huge concatenated histories — looks like a long-prompt churn case, memory grows during the warmup/prefill step and never trims.

dave: impact: ~12% of requests to this pool are failing and being retried -> increased latency for affected customers, some streaming responses are cut short. Not yet full customer outage but visible degradation.

sana: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily disable warmup prefetch on that model variant, 2) route long-context requests to smaller-ram model (llama-xxl-2048), 3) enable aggressive prefix eviction (evict-after=2mb). Can we roll these quickly?

raj: patching runtime config now. applying gate on route rules: `if context_tokens > 65536 -> route=llama-xxl-2048` to take effect at edge. Rolling config to 3 hotpool nodes first.

raj: kubectl commands I ran: `kubectl cordon node/gpu-7 && kubectl drain node/gpu-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30` (move hotpool out to avoid restarts).

dave: confirmed routing change propagated to gateway (seen in proxy logs). hotpool restart throttle enabled. watching for OOMs.

cust-ops: I'm drafting a short customer note — affected subset: customers on route tag `enterprise-longctx` between 02:08-02:30 UTC, experiencing increased retry rates. ETA for full rollback: 20-30m depending on stabilization.

ingrid: if OOMs stop, we'll leave eviction enabled and schedule a follow-up to add a model-side memory cap and more graceful trimming.

raj: update: after switching routing and disabling warmup prefetch, OOM events dropped from ~8/min to ~0-1/min across the pool. node/gpu-7 remains drained.

dave: handoff: Night oncall @sana will take post-mortem ownership. I'll add runbook notes and follow up with customer comms. If OOMs reappear escalate to SRE lead. :thumbsup:

sana: taking it. adding checklist: reproduce locally, add unit test for prefix-trim, schedule canary rollout of memory-cap change tomorrow morning.

incident-bot: Thread closed for bridge updates; ongoing monitoring in metrics channel.
